about_blocks.text: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island - Center Overview
about_blocks.html: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island - Center Overview

about_blocks.text: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island is a pioneering residential treatment center that provides a unique approach to helping our clients achieve optimal health and wellness. As part of The Sanctuary World, we are committed to delivering the highest quality care that is private, secure and discreet.
about_blocks.html: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island is a pioneering residential treatment center that provides a unique approach to helping our clients achieve optimal health and wellness. As part of The Sanctuary World, we are committed to delivering the highest quality care that is private, secure and discreet.

about_blocks.text: Our treatment experience is designed to cater to the specific requirements and expectations of our VIP clientele. We offer a range of private, luxury medical care, therapeutic retreats, and rehabilitation programs that address a full spectrum of health issues. With an evidence-based approach and integrated teams that have extensive experience in dealing with complexity, we provide solutions for addiction issues, mental health problems, complex medical management and rejuvenation, to general wellness. Our programs include weight loss, post-operative rehabilitation, and general performance enhancement that aim to help our clients regain control of their lives, and shape their future with confidence, contentment, and focus.

faqs.question: What is The Sanctuary Vancouver Island?

answer_blocks.text: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island is a luxury, private therapeutic retreat for high-profile clients.
answer_blocks.html: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island is a luxury, private therapeutic retreat for high-profile clients.

answer_blocks.text: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island treats addiction and mental health conditions with a holistic approach.
answer_blocks.html: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island treats addiction and mental health conditions with a holistic approach.

faqs.question: What kind of care do they offer?

answer_blocks.text: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island offers highly individualized care with no group therapy or shared facilities.
answer_blocks.html: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island offers highly individualized care with no group therapy or shared facilities.

faqs.question: What kind of therapies do they offer?

answer_blocks.text: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island offers medical care, psychotherapy, and complementary therapies like bodywork, transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS), brain mapping, and biofeedback therapies.
answer_blocks.html: The Sanctuary Vancouver Island offers medical care, psychotherapy, and complementary therapies like bodywork, transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS), brain mapping, and biofeedback therapies.

faqs.question: Can additional modalities be integrated into the program?

answer_blocks.text: Yes, additional modalities like reflexology, osteopathy, dentistry, kinesiology, and pilates can be integrated into the program.
answer_blocks.html: Yes, additional modalities like reflexology, osteopathy, dentistry, kinesiology, and pilates can be integrated into the program.
